findings.highlight: I run, suppressing my raging heart
findings.evidenceJa: 荒れ狂う心音、狂いそうな動悸を抑えて走り出す
findings.governingReading: He starts running while suppressing the violent heartbeat and palpitations that feel capable of driving him mad.
findings.explanation: The doubled cardiac panic and threat of madness collapse into a generic raging heart.

findings.highlight: The unease in my back remains
findings.evidenceJa: 背中に張り付いた不安は、まだ剥がれない
findings.governingReading: The unease clinging to my back still will not peel away.
findings.explanation: The physical pursuit image is reduced to an odd location phrase.

findings.highlight: I was really relieved, knowing that I could come back to you
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーのところに帰ってきて良かったって、心底ホッとした
findings.governingReading: I was relieved from the bottom of my heart that I had come back to you, Saber.
findings.explanation: Relief at the accomplished return to Saber becomes relief at possessing the ability to return.

findings.governingReading: If there is something in return for him.
findings.explanation: Payment or reciprocal benefit is mistranslated as security pledged against an obligation.

findings.evidenceJa: ランサーは気持ちのいい英霊です
findings.governingReading: Lancer is a refreshingly straightforward Heroic Spirit.
findings.explanation: Saber’s personal appraisal of his temperament becomes a judgment of martial worth.

findings.highlight: N-No… umyes, some more tea, please
findings.evidenceJa: い、いえ、そのそう、お茶のお代わりをお願いします
findings.explanation: The stammered pivot is fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: getting such rude pressure from the Servant of the man who shot me
findings.evidenceJa: かつてこの胸を撃ち抜いた男のサーヴァントに、ここまで不躾な殺気を向けられては
findings.governingReading: to have such insolent killing intent directed at me by the Servant of the man who once shot through this chest
findings.explanation: Both the bodily wound and Saber’s killing intent are generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 過保護すぎるようだな
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s taunt about Saber’s protective conduct becomes an inward emotional trait.

findings.highlight: I can see the mansion clearly
findings.evidenceJa: 屋敷の造りも把握できる
findings.governingReading: I can grasp the layout of the mansion.
findings.explanation: Tactical knowledge of the house’s structure becomes mere visibility.

findings.highlight: He throws something onto the grass
findings.evidenceJa: 何か、得体の知れないモノを投げた
findings.governingReading: He threw some unidentified, unfathomable thing onto the grass.
findings.explanation: The object’s deliberate unknowability at first sight disappears.

findings.highlight: it looks like it can only be the corpse of a small child
findings.evidenceJa: 幼い抜け殻にしか見えないもの
findings.governingReading: something that can only look like a young, empty shell
findings.explanation: The English identifies a corpse before the source’s staged correction that the apparent shell is alive.
The result of the attack is weakened from destruction to piercing.

findings.highlight: I’m spewing out blood from my mouth like a hose. mouth.
findings.evidenceJa: 口から溢れるように血を吐いている
findings.governingReading: blood is pouring as I vomit it from my mouth
findings.explanation: An unsupported hose simile and stray repeated word replace the source’s overflow image.

findings.highlight: What fills my body is wonder
findings.evidenceJa: 体を支配していたのは疑問だけだった
findings.governingReading: Only the question ruled his body.
findings.explanation: Total domination by a question becomes the milder and semantically different feeling of wonder.
